deselectHint: Optional. Tap a chosen option again to clear it.
bodyShapeHint: Helps the stylist balance proportions. Weight is never sent to the AI.
fit: How do you like clothes to fit?
undertoneHelp: Warm: veins look greener and gold flatters you. Cool: veins look bluer and silver flatters you. Neutral: both, or you are not sure.
styleNotes: Anything else the stylist should know? (optional)
styleNotesPlaceholder: e.g. I prefer to cover my arms; no skinny jeans; I run warm.
seasonEmpty: Add your undertone, hair or eye colour and the stylist will work out which colours flatter you near the face.

spring.summary: warm, clear and light: ivory, camel, warm navy, coral, warm greens and golden browns

summer.summary: cool, soft and light: soft white, dove grey, powder and slate blue, rose, lavender and soft navy

autumn.summary: warm, rich and muted: cream, camel, olive, rust, chocolate, forest green and warm navy

winter.summary: cool, clear and high-contrast: crisp white, black, charcoal, true navy, burgundy, emerald and icy tones
